Exposure to lead has adverse health impacts
as lead is toxic to the heart, bones, kidneys and other organs and tissues.
Cincinnati, Ohio (in the USA)
has a history of paediatric lead poisoning
from paint, dust and soil.
One study [@data:dietrich:leadexposure]
examined the impact of lead exposure on infants in this area.

Read the 
Abstract of the research article below
and select the best answer from the choices that follow.
Then,
discuss your answers with the class,
and explain the reason for your choices.
**Make sure you explain why the other options are incorrect.**
	
> The primary purpose of this paper is to report on the relationship between prenatal/postnatal 
> lead exposure and the development status of 2-year-old infants in the Cincinnati cohort.  
> &nbsp;
>
> It was hypothesized that low to moderate prenatal and postnatal lead exposure would be 
> adversely associated with indexes of 2-year neurobehavioural development after adjustment 
> for relevant covariates or confounders.
> &nbsp;
>
> --- @data:dietrich:leadexposure, p. 14


1. Which one of these is most likely the *population* under study?

    a. 2-year-old infants in Cincinnati.
    b. The number of 2-year-old infants in Cincinnati.
    c. People living in Cincinnati.
    d. Those who participated in the study.

2. Which one of these is most likely the *outcome* in the study?

    a. The average amount of prenatal lead exposure.
    b. The relationship between lead exposure and development status.
    c. The average of the indexes of the 2-year neurobehavioural development.
    d. The amount of postnatal lead exposure.

3. Which one of these is most likely the *comparison* in the study?

    a. Between prenatal and postnatal lead exposure.
    b. Between low-to-moderate pre/post exposure to lead and no pre/post exposure.
    c. Between 2-year-olds and other children.
    d. Between 2-year-olds in Cincinnati and elsewhere.

4. Which one of these is most likely the *intervention* in the study?

    a. The lead exposure.
    b. Indexes of 2-year neurobehavioral development.
    c. The medication given to the children.
    d. There is no intervention.

5. Which one of these is most likely the *unit of observation* in the study?

    a. The index of the 2-year neurobehavioral development.
    b. The children.
    c. The symptoms of the children.
    d. The dose of lead.

6. Which one of these is most likely the *unit of analysis* in the study?

    a. The index of the 2-year neurobehavioral development.
    b. The children.
    c. The symptoms of the children.
    d. The dose of lead.
